prompt.card.attachments.text: Its attachments (open them by path): {paths}{more, select, yes {, and {moreCount} more (cw_read_task lists them)} other {}}.
prompt.card.attachments.note: HI-1700: the paths of up to 10 of its attachments, joined with commas; more: yes when it has more than that, moreCount of them.

prompt.card.backFrom.text: It was in {column} and is back in Doing for more work.
prompt.card.backFrom.note: More work on a card from Review, Passed or Done. column: the column it came from, by its name (Review, Passed, Done).

prompt.card.commentCut.note: A latest comment over 4,000 characters: its start, cut.

prompt.card.comments.text: The card has {n, plural, one {{count} comment} other {{count} comments}}: read {again, select, yes {the rest} other {them}} with cw_read_task.
prompt.card.comments.note: After the skill line, when the card has comments. count: how many (n, as text); again: yes for more work on a card, whose latest comment the prompt carries.

prompt.card.dependsOn.note: The cards it is blocked by, joined with commas (AM-3, AM-4).

prompt.card.latestComment.note: More work on a card: the feedback it came back with. by: who wrote it; date: YYYY-MM-DD; comment: its text (prompt.card.commentCut when long).

prompt.card.skill.laneBuilder.text: Use the card-loop skill as this lane's builder.
prompt.card.skill.laneBuilder.note: HI-2047: a running lane's builder works its cards in turn with card-loop (which does each with work-on-card), not work-on-card as well.

prompt.card.skill.workOnCard.note: With Hive's tools: how to carry a card through is the work-on-card skill's, so the prompt only points there.

prompt.card.start.text: Work on task {card} from the Combwork task board: {title}
prompt.card.start.note: The first line of a card's start prompt. card: its key (AM-12), or #12 for a card with none.

prompt.context.broken.text: {n, plural, one {This reference no longer resolves} other {These references no longer resolve}}: {problems}. Ask the user which section is meant, or read the closest.
prompt.context.broken.note: #819: never silently nothing: the references that no longer resolve (prompt.context.problem), joined with "; ".

prompt.context.howToRead.text: cw_read_section reads {ok, select, yes {each} other {the closest}} as the card has it (path: the file; heading: # and the slug{ok, select, yes { after it, none for a whole file} other {}}; from: "project").
prompt.context.howToRead.note: #818, #819: from the copy the card was checked against, the project's, whatever folder the agent works in. ok: yes when some references resolve (else only the closest headings are named).

prompt.context.item.note: A doc section to read first, with its size: "1.2k", "56k".

prompt.context.problem.text: {ref} ({problem, select, notFound {no such file} noHeading {no such heading} ambiguous {several headings have its text} invalid {not a doc section} outside {not in the project} hidden {in Combwork's or git's own folder} notMarkdown {not Markdown} tooBig {too big to read} other {}}{closest, select, yes {; {problem, select, ambiguous {they are} other {closest}}: {headings}} other {}})
prompt.context.problem.note: Why a reference doesn't resolve: "docs/PLAN.md#setup (no such heading; closest: #install)". headings: the closest, each as #slug, joined with commas.

prompt.context.readFirst.note: #818: the doc sections the card says to read first (prompt.context.item), joined with commas; the agent fetches what it needs.

prompt.context.readFirstNoTools.text: Read these sections of the project's docs first: {list}.
prompt.context.readFirstNoTools.note: #818: as prompt.context.readFirst, for an agent without Hive's tools.
